no_adcom_quote.quote: No advisory committee discussion or consultations external to the FDA were deemed necessary for this BLA application.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the approval of ENHERTU (fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan, BLA761139). In Section 9 of the Multidiscipline Review, the FDA states that no advisory committee discussion or external consultations were deemed necessary for this BLA. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to changes in the approval.
